description: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) vectors for actionwitness_core. Each accept vector pairs a parsed input value with the exact canonical UTF-8 text. Reject vectors carry a non-finite float the canonicalizer must refuse rather than encode.

origins.published: Traceable to RFC 8785's own normative text and worked example.
origins.repository: Authored for this project's shapes and known failure modes.

accept.name: rfc8785-worked-example
accept.description: RFC 8785's own worked example: member reordering, ES6 number forms, minimal string escaping, and a literal non-ASCII character.

accept.name: number-exponent-boundaries
accept.description: ES6 switches to exponential form at >= 1e21 and below 1e-6, and pads no exponent digits. A serializer reusing a host language's float repr usually gets at least one of these three wrong.

accept.name: number-zero-and-sign
accept.description: Minus zero canonicalizes to 0, so two inputs that compare equal produce one hash. Trailing zeros and redundant exponents collapse.

accept.name: string-escaping-minimal
accept.description: Only quote, backslash and C0 controls are escaped; solidus is not, and non-ASCII is emitted literally as UTF-8. Over-escaping is the common failure and changes the hash.

accept.name: key-ordering-utf16-code-units
accept.description: Keys sort by UTF-16 code unit, not code point. An astral key begins with a high surrogate (0xD83D), which orders BEFORE a BMP key above 0xD800 (0xFB00) but AFTER it by code point. Python's default sorted() sorts by code point and gets this backwards.

accept.name: nesting-and-empties
accept.description: Array order is data and is never sorted; object order is not. Empty object and empty array are distinct canonical forms.

accept.name: repo-observation-snapshot
accept.description: A shape this project actually hashes: money as exact decimal strings (never floats), UTC instants, and a target-namespaced observation.

accept.name: repo-event-record
accept.description: An append-only event as hashed for the evidence chain: null members are retained, not dropped, so an absent field and a null field differ.

reject.name: nan
reject.reason: NaN has no JSON representation and no canonical form.
